metadata.description: Gradual of the Poor Clares of Mulhouse, 13th–14th century, with additions of the 15th–16th; square notation on four red lines (IRHT, Arca). The gradual stands on ff. 291r–292r, which Corpus Monodicum's images label 0289v, 0290, 0290v. Images: IRHT.
metadata.transcription: Corpus Monodicum (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz / Universität Würzburg), document Mul 2-0289v-9TR, https://stagedata.corpus-monodicum.de/mei/f517be20-550c-4f28-ab92-fa51481bf994/Mul%202-0289v-9TR.xml (respond) and document Mul 2-0290-4TR, https://stagedata.corpus-monodicum.de/mei/351c398d-18d9-4d0e-b3f2-383a37095bfd/Mul%202-0290-4TR.xml (verse), corrected against the facsimile for eChant (see corpus-monodicum-corrected/corrections.md). Pitches read an octave lower than there.
